description.zh: 您需要删除的Group ID所在实例的ID。
description.en: The ApsaraMQ for MQTT instance ID.

descriptions.zh: 每成功调用一次**DeleteGroupId**接口，都会计算为一次消息TPS，从而影响您的计费。计费详情，请参见[计费说明](~~52819~~)。
descriptions.en: Each successful call to the **DeleteGroupId** operation counts as one messaging TPS and affects your billing. [Billing rules](~~52819~~).

example.unifiedCli: aliyun onsmqtt delete-group-id --group-id GID_test --instance-id mqtt-cn-0pp1ldu0000 --api-version 2020-04-20 --region cn-hangzhou
